body.name: residual certificate-compilation transition
body.construction: Write \(\zeta\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{res}}\zeta'\) iff \(\Sigma=\mathcal F=\mathcal L=\varnothing\), the sole residual token \(r=(R,K,\mathcal J,\mathcal P,\mathcal C)\) is present, and the first candidate in encoded order passes an exact verifier. A projection candidate \(P/D\in\mathcal P\) passes when \(D\) is the product of its reduced denominators, every factor carries a \(\mathcal L_H^{\mathrm{pos}}\) factorization certificate, and \(D\,t_{a,H}^N-P(o_H^N)\) reduces to zero modulo \(\mathcal J\); emit \((F_H,\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{den}},\mathfrak D_H)=(P/D,\operatorname{factors}(D),\mathfrak D_H)\). A contrast candidate \(d\in\mathcal C\) contains two rational affine primitive-coordinate maps on its recorded box and passes when substitution of those two maps into \(o_H^N\) gives identical polynomials, substitution into \(t_{a,H}^N\) gives a nonzero polynomial of constant sign certified by rational coefficient bounds, and every primitive probability, admissible cell, and value of \(s_H^N\) has the sign required for exact support \(H\). Apply \(\rho_H\) to the two maps and emit \(b\mapsto(\theta_b^+,\theta_b^-)\). Consume the residual token, set the terminal flag, and halt. The target identity, the ledger factorizations, and the displayed twin identities and inequalities are the local proof obligations; no unrestricted quantifier elimination is invoked.
